title: King For A Day
lyrics:
[00:09.02]Dare me to jump off of this Jersey bridge
[00:11.54]I bet you never had a Friday night like this!
[00:13.57]Keep it up, keep it up, let's raise our hands
[00:15.76]I take a look up at the sky, and I see red
[00:17.70]Red for the cancer, red for the wealthy
[00:19.71]Red for the drink that's mixed with suicide
[00:22.46]Everything red!
[00:26.41]Please, won't you push me for the last time?
[00:29.15]Let's scream until there's nothing left
[00:31.67]So sick of playing, I don't want this anymore
[00:34.96]The thought of you's no fucking fun
[00:37.10]You want a martyr? I'll be one!
[00:40.20]Because enough's enough, we're done!
[00:44.50]You told me, "Think about it," well, I did!(I did)
[00:48.70]Now, I don't wanna feel a thing anymore
[00:52.97]I'm tired of begging for the things that I want
[00:57.24]I'm over-sleeping like a dog on the floor
[01:04.28]Yeah!
[01:08.85]The thing I think I love will surely bring me pain
[01:13.17]Intoxication, paranoia and a lot of fame
[01:17.34]Three cheers for throwing up, pubescent drama queen(Oh-ho!)
[01:21.54]You make me sick, I make it worse by drinking late
[01:26.13]Scream(Scream)
[01:29.12]Until there's nothing left
[01:31.23]So sick of playing, I don't want to anymore
[01:34.42]The thought of you's no fucking fun
[01:36.61]You want a martyr? I'll be one!
[01:39.77]Because enough's enough, we're done!
[01:43.93]You told me, "Think about it," well, I did!
[01:46.35]Well, I did!
[01:48.24]Now, I don't wanna feel a thing anymore
[01:50.60]Anymore!
[01:52.46]I'm tired of begging for the things that I want
[01:56.72]I'm over-sleeping like a dog on the floor
[02:01.00]Imagine living like a king someday
[02:05.24]A single night without a ghost in the walls
[02:09.47]And if the bass shakes the earth underground
[02:13.79]We'll start a new revolution now
[02:20.93]Now!
[02:23.54]Alright, here we go
[02:25.73]Hail Mary, forgive me
[02:30.09]Blood for blood, hearts beating
[02:34.58]Come at me, now this is war
[02:40.47]Fuck with this new beat(Oh!)
[02:59.50]Now!
[03:00.27]Terror begins inside a bloodless vein
[03:02.33]I was just a product of the street youth rage
[03:04.51]Born in this world without a voice or say
[03:06.69]Caught in the spokes with an abandoned brain
[03:08.75]I know you well, but this ain't a game
[03:10.99]Blow the smoke in diamond shape
[03:13.18]Dying is a gift, so close your eyes
[03:15.94]And rest in peace
[03:18.86]You told me, "Think about it," well, I did!
[03:23.07]Now, I don't wanna feel a thing anymore
[03:27.35]I'm tired of begging for the things that I want
[03:31.59]I'm over-sleeping like a dog on the floor
[03:35.84]Imagine living like a king someday
[03:40.06]A single night without a ghost in the walls
[03:44.29]We are the shadows screaming, "Take us now!"
[03:48.60]We'd rather die than live to rust on the ground!(Shit)
